projecthero.guide.undead.regen.body: Your body is ten segments: head, body, both arms and both legs (down to the wrist and ankle), both hands and both feet. A lost segment waits a second and a half, then grows back. A lost arm and its hand (or leg and its foot) grow back together in exactly one second, as one growth from the shoulder or hip right out to the fingertips or toes; the head takes 0.75s, the body 0.9s, and a hand or foot lost on its own about half a second. First bone, then raw muscle, then your skin coming back over it pixel by pixel, with a soft hiss. They grow in order, like a real body: nothing starts before what it grows from has grown out to it: a hand comes out of its arm as the growth reaches the wrist (never floating on its own), a foot as it reaches the ankle, the legs once the body's has reached the hips, the arms once the body is past the shoulders and the body once the head has started. Regrowth is always on and costs no food, but a hungry body heals slower: at full speed with 9 or more drumsticks, slowing down to a quarter of the speed at 3 drumsticks or fewer, and nothing at all when your food bar is empty. Your health comes back on its own, half a heart every quarter of a second when you are well fed, even mid-fight (a quarter as much when hungry); lost parts wait and regrow up to four times as long, and a part already growing back stops halfway while you are starving. A hand you don't have holds nothing: the item stays in its slot but can't be used or swung until the hand is back. A part that comes off without being thrown stays standing where it was for a moment, falls over and crumbles away. Shift + hold V for a second to Reform: every missing or regrowing part whole on the spot, 3 hearts healed and fire, poison and wither gone (20 second cooldown).
projecthero.guide.saiyan.rage.body: Your Rage bar fills as you fight: 2 for every health you lose and 1 for every hit you land, half as much again below half health. Out of combat for 15 seconds it slowly drains. At 100, press H to become a Super Saiyan for exactly 3 minutes: 35% more damage, 20% faster, +4 armour and double Ki regeneration, with a golden aura (and your tail turns gold). Rage empties when you transform. When the time is up you are exhausted for 60 seconds, and Rage must fill again from 0.
projecthero.guide.saiyan.tail.body: Every Saiyan has a furry monkey tail. It sways behind you, streams back when you run and wraps round your waist when you crouch. It is brown, and changes colour with you: gold as a Super Saiyan, red under Kaioken. Only other players see it (never in first person).
projecthero.guide.saiyan.landing.body: Come down fast from flight and you land like a hero: one knee and a fist into the ground, a golden Ki burst and a crater of dust. As a Super Saiyan the burst is bigger and shakes the ground harder. It never takes fall damage and breaks no blocks.
projecthero.guide.saiyan.calm.body: Legends say a Saiyan pushed to the very edge by a far stronger enemy, and who keeps standing, can find a calm beyond anger.
message.projecthero.saiyan.ui_unlocked: Your body moves before you can think... something has awakened in you.
message.projecthero.saiyan.ui_unlocked_h: As a Super Saiyan with 50 Ki, press H again: Ultra Instinct. A silver calm for up to 30 s: your body dodges most punches and arrows on its own, you are faster, and a hit right after a dodge is a counter. It burns 3 Ki a second and leaves you exhausted.
message.projecthero.saiyan.ui_already: You are already in Ultra Instinct
message.projecthero.saiyan.ui_exhausted: Your body can not reach that calm again yet (%1$s s)
message.projecthero.saiyan.ui_over: Ultra Instinct fades. You are exhausted.
